title: Pandora Nox wins Drag Race Germany
summary: In the Grand Finale (DE-S01-E12), Pandora Nox, Metamorkid, and Yvonne Nightstand lip-synced to Conchita Wurst's "Rise Like a Phoenix". Pandora Nox was crowned Germany's first Drag Superstar; Metamorkid and Yvonne Nightstand finished as runners-up. Pandora Nox was the first AFAB winner in Drag Race franchise history.

title: Barbie Q: Germany's first Porkchop
summary: Barbie Q was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Germany (DE-S01-E02), lip-syncing to Dua Lipa's "Break My Heart" against Victoria Shakespears after a double shantay spared both in episode 1.

title: Germany's opening double shantay
summary: In DE-S01-E01, Tessa Testicle and Victoria Shakespears lip-synced to Shirin David's "Lieben wir". Both won the lip sync and no one went home — the season's first double shantay.

title: Victoria Shakespears crowned Miss Darling
summary: At the reunion (DE-S01-E11), Victoria Shakespears was voted Miss Darling by her fellow contestants — Germany's equivalent of Miss Congeniality.
